# NFL Daily — 2026-11-11 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Vikings reacquired QB Kirk Cousins from the Raiders for a third-round pick; coach Kevin O'Connell hasn't fully committed to him as the Week 10 starter yet. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/kirk-cousins-traded-vikings-raiders-gave-option-stay-leave-franchise-per-report/)
- Raiders named rookie Fernando Mendoza their starting QB after trading away Cousins. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/raiders-fernando-mendoza-offensive-rookie-year-favorite-first-nfl-start/)
- Chiefs traded for Colts WR Josh Downs to bolster Patrick Mahomes' receiving corps. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/chiefs-agree-to-acquire-wr-josh-downs-in-trade-with-colts-per-report/)
- 49ers acquired WR Keenan Allen from the Colts for a 2027 sixth-round pick. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2120580183589880060)
- Bengals' trade-deadline deal for Eagles DE Arnold Ebiketie collapsed; coach Zac Taylor apologized, saying "it was on our end." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50454351/bengals-zac-taylor-apologizes-failed-trade-eagles)
- Former NFL head coach Rex Ryan was arrested in Nashville, accused of striking two pedestrians with his truck and leaving the scene. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/former-nfl-head-coach-rex-ryan-arrested-nashville-police-striking-two-pedestrians-truck/)

## Transactions
- Chiefs acquired WR Josh Downs from the Colts, waiving WR Nikko Remigio and DE Jack Pyburn. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/transactions)

## Injuries
- Cardinals QB Gardner Minshew II (elbow) is out for the season and will undergo UCL surgery; rookie Carson Beck starts Sunday vs. the Rams. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Dolphins QB Malik Willis is out at least four games after being placed on IR; the team hasn't ruled out season-ending surgery. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/malik-willis-injured-reserve-dolphins-quarterbacks)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua will be out for a "significant period of time," per coach Sean McVay, though roster mechanics will keep him off IR. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2120621139525263707)
- Packers RB Josh Jacobs is out with a broken ring finger that needs surgery; he could return in 2-3 weeks, with an IR decision expected Saturday. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2120576036958060601)
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (elbow) is expected to practice fully Wednesday and remains on track for Sunday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50454081/chiefs-sticking-harrison-butker-kicker-vs-falcons)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-11 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Ravens named Jacoby Brissett their starting QB for Monday night; with Lamar Jackson (thumb) on IR, Baltimore becomes just the third team since 1950 to start four different QBs in four straight weeks. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2120576110517723389)
- Ravens traded G Andrew Vorhees and a conditional 2028 sixth-round pick to the Falcons for C Ryan Neuzil; coach Jesse Minter said Cam Jurgens remains the starting center, with Neuzil added as a depth and versatility piece. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-trade-ryan-neuzil-andrew-vorhees-offensive-lineman-atlanta-falcons)
- Ravens are searching for a new kicker: Tyler Loop (groin) is on IR and Jake Moody left to sign with the Falcons off Baltimore's practice squad; the team worked out free agents including Riley Patterson and Harrison Mevis Wednesday with no decision made. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2120583025994125610)
- Ravens released TE Nick Vannett among several other roster moves. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-roster-moves-nick-vannett-kyle-hergel-michael-jordan-lucas-scott)
- DT Nnamdi Madubuike said he's heard buzz that Lamar Jackson could return this season, though he clarified he didn't hear it directly from Jackson. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2120561444702093668)

# Rivals — 2026-11-11 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Steelers let the trade deadline pass without making any deals. [Post-Gazette](https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/steelers/2026/11/10/steelers-trade-deadline-news/stories/202611100026)
- Bengals' trade-deadline deal for Eagles DE Arnold Ebiketie collapsed; coach Zac Taylor apologized, saying "it was on our end." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50454351/bengals-zac-taylor-apologizes-failed-trade-eagles)
- Browns will start Deshaun Watson (returning from concussion protocol) over Shedeur Sanders in Week 10 vs. the Texans. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/browns-start-deshaun-watson-over-shedeur-sanders-texans/)
- Chiefs traded for Colts WR Josh Downs to bolster Patrick Mahomes' receiving corps. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/chiefs-agree-to-acquire-wr-josh-downs-in-trade-with-colts-per-report/)
- Bills landed Titans S Amani Hooker; Tennessee's GM said he'd turned away Buffalo's GM for about a week before the deal came together. [Garafolo](https://x.com/MikeGarafolo/status/2120561727515332880)

## Transactions
- Chiefs acquired WR Josh Downs from the Colts, waiving WR Nikko Remigio and DE Jack Pyburn. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/transactions)

## Injuries
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (elbow) is expected to practice fully Wednesday and remains on track for Sunday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50454081/chiefs-sticking-harrison-butker-kicker-vs-falcons)
- Steelers DT Derrick Harmon's 21-day practice window opens off IR. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/pittsburgh-steelers-get-massive-injury-news-on-star-defensive-tackle.html)
- Browns QB Deshaun Watson (concussion) is cleared to start Sunday vs. the Texans. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/browns-start-deshaun-watson-over-shedeur-sanders-texans/)
- Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) remains on IR; his practice window won't open this week. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
